# Solana Alpha

> Tracking reward-generating assets and wealth-building instruments on Solana

## URLs

- Dashboard: https://marvelus-tech.github.io/solana-alpha/
- Repository: https://github.com/marvelus-tech/solana-alpha
- Agent guide: https://github.com/marvelus-tech/solana-alpha/blob/main/AGENTS.md

## Description

Read-only dashboard tracking:
- 62 curated hold-to-earn / reward-generating Solana tokens
- 8 Strategy Inc (MSTR) instruments: common stock, preferreds, tokenized equity, synthetic trackers

All with entry/current prices and PnL tracking from addition date.

## Agent-Callable

### WebMCP (Browser Agents)
Open https://marvelus-tech.github.io/solana-alpha/ — tools auto-register via document.modelContext

### Remote MCP (Non-Browser Agents)
Endpoint: https://solana-alpha-mcp.YOURACCOUNT.workers.dev/mcp  
Protocol: Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC  
Deploy: See mcp-worker/README.md

### Direct JSON
- Scout: https://marvelus-tech.github.io/solana-alpha/data/scout-findings.json
- Strategy: https://marvelus-tech.github.io/solana-alpha/data/strategy-stack.json

## Tools

6 read-only tools, all return envelope `{ok, data, meta, delight}`:
1. describe_site — What Solana Alpha is, sections, jobs
2. describe_page — Page metadata, canonical URL
3. list_scout_assets — 62 hold-to-earn tokens
4. list_strategy_stack — 8 Strategy instruments
5. get_asset — Lookup by ticker (FLOCK, MSTR, etc.)
6. get_overview — Counts and confidence stats

## Voice

Precise, dry, curator, light trading-desk, restrained. No hype. Delight beats optional (18 rotating lines, skip for serious contexts).

## Data Refresh

Hourly via GitHub Action. Last enriched timestamp in JSON files.
